name: Waymate
tagline: Waymate is a walking ideas app for people whose best thoughts come in motion, not at a desk
description: Waymate is a walking ideas app for people whose best thoughts come in motion, not at a desk. Instead of another aggressive fitness tracker, it gives you a calm step counter that quietly follows your daily movement and turns walks into a space for thinking. You see your steps and trends without streaks, or pressure, while every spark of inspiration that appears on the move can be saved in a couple of taps.
